formulations.Polymer system Notes: Amorphous oxyethylene-oxymethylene copolymer with randomly-spaced oxy-methylene units inserted into linear PEO chain. Formula: -[(CH2-CH2-O)n-CH2-O]-m, where n varies randomly around 9 and m is about 600.
formulations.Arrhenius notes: Arrhenius plots given in Fig. 4 for various concentrations (Li:O ratios from 64:1 to 1:1).
formulations.Notes: Conductivity values read from Fig. 5 (Log10 conductivity vs dopant level). Values are approximate from plot reading. Salt concentration given as Li:O ratio of 24:1 corresponds to ~3 wt% LiClO4. Polymer structure described in Introduction: -[(CH2-CH2-O)n-CH2-O]-m with n~9, m~600.
formulations.Reference: E. Linden and J.R. Owen, Solid State Ionics 28-30 (1988) 994-1000
